title: Implement per-user data root resolution (LOREWEAVER_HOME + per-platform defaults)
description: Per ADR 0004. Resolve a single per-user Loreweaver data root: LOREWEAVER_HOME override, else the platform per-user default — Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\Loreweaver, macOS/Linux ~/.loreweaver. Create root + subdirs (config.json, registry.json, campaigns/, rules-packs/, dolt/) lazily. rules-packs/ is reserved for epic loreweaver-x3w and stays empty for now. The managed Dolt cache is <root>/dolt; LOREWEAVER_DOLT_HOME still overrides it.
close_reason: Implemented and merged in PR #40 (ADR 0004 managed storage model).
